module_summary: Receive side of a clock-domain edge propagator: cc_sync_wedge synchronizes the incoming level, returns it as ack and pulses valid on its rising edge.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Incoming level from transmit domain, synchronized by child wedge.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse on rising edge of synchronized valid_i.

anchors.name: ack_o
anchors.why: Synchronized level returned to transmitter as acknowledge.

groups.name: rx_synchronizer
groups.description: Child synchronizing edge detector producing valid pulse and ack level.
